descriptions.pc88:189324: A text adventure loosely based on Tetsu Yano's novel The Dagger of Kamui.
descriptions.pc88:189325: A comic role-playing game: a Time Patrol officer travels into the past to find out why his sweetheart was taken, through about a hundred events; in battle you strike a monster's head, body or legs, and actions get easier the more often you succeed at them.
descriptions.pc88:189658: A Chinese-style comedy adventure: a mysterious stranger hands the hero, training in the mountains with his master, a sage's last will.
descriptions.pc88:189659: A mix of action role-playing and shooter: Zaider searches for people to rescue.
descriptions.pc88:189660: An action adventure: Hyakkimaru, whose body parts were taken by demons before his birth, hunts them down to reclaim them.
descriptions.pc88:189661: Technosoft's overhead multi-directional shooter with role-playing elements.
descriptions.pc88:189663: Investigate the destruction of a military research ship near the L-2 space colony as its lone survivor in a science-fiction adventure.
descriptions.pc88:189664: The sequel to Lagrange L-2, starting in the shuttle right after the first game's ending, with Zera missiles already closing in.
descriptions.pc88:189665: In 2027, a quarter century after a Soviet nuclear strike shattered Tokyo, the martial-arts dictator who seized the ruins as the nation of Tokio is dying, and a brain transplant would bring him back. As a knife-wielding CIA agent you infiltrate to stop it, moving with the keypad, attacking by stepping next to enemies and recruiting odd allies. Third in the series after Shanghai and Kyu Ryu Tou.
descriptions.pc88:189666: A role-playing game mixing turn-based and action battles.
descriptions.pc88:189667: An action game in Sequential Circuit City, a future city overrun by demons: fight as a cyborg remade by someone for the cause of justice, whose appearance changes as he gains experience.
descriptions.pc88:189704: T&E Soft's 1983 sci-fi adventure: Star Arthur's adventures on the planet Mephius.
descriptions.pc88:189705: The second Star Arthur adventure, set in the Dark Nebula.
descriptions.pc88:189805: A 3D racing game, an updated version of the PC-8001 game of the same name.
descriptions.pc88:189880: An early pinball game with a colorful table packed with features, including a slot machine.
descriptions.pc88:189881: An overhead scrolling shooter: the people of the star M3 have built a huge super-weapon, and a lone fighter flies against it.
descriptions.pc88:189882: Technosoft's early real-time strategy shooter: pilot a transforming craft while producing and sending units to destroy the enemy base.
descriptions.pc88:189883: A detective adventure: a staged kidnapping meant to stop a political marriage turns into a real abduction.
descriptions.pc88:189884: A short romance adventure in which a love story unfolds while sightseeing around Kobe.
descriptions.pc88:189885: A shooter alternating vertically scrolling stages with into-the-screen 3D stages, ten in all, flown in the fighter Nights Over Egypt. Red, yellow and blue drops power up the air shot, ground bombs and shield, with a weapon level-up after six pickups without dying; giant bosses end the 2D stages. Pressing F5 on the title screen opens a music mode.
descriptions.pc88:189926: An action adventure: land on an alien planet and collect what you need to leave.
descriptions.pc88:189928: A Space Harrier-style behind-view shooter: a heavily armed robot runs into the screen against alien forces.
descriptions.pc88:189930: An action simulation game designed by Kow Yokoyama, creator of Maschinen Krieger.
descriptions.pc88:189931: A shooting game in six stages: Calamity takes a well-paid job delivering a trunk and is attacked by squadrons of fighters, picking missiles and other weapons from a rack as he goes.
descriptions.pc88:189932: A role-playing game set in Edo-period Japan.
descriptions.pc88:189934: A time travel adventure: after his girlfriend Aiko is killed, the hero takes his uncle's time machine back to save her.
descriptions.pc88:189937: The second of Bond Soft's Time Series adventures, a time travel story.
descriptions.pc88:189939: A comic adventure: a pirate is sent by his boss to settle a matter at sea.
descriptions.pc88:189941: A music role-playing game set around the kingdom of Symphonia.
descriptions.pc88:189982: A business game for one to four players: drill for oil and become the richest oil king.
descriptions.pc88:189983: A fishing game: choose a lure and reel in black bass.
descriptions.pc88:189984: Hudson's action game: shoot the bouncing balls, which split into smaller ones each time they are hit.
descriptions.pc88:189993: A first-person tank battle in which you command the tank by issuing orders rather than steering it.
descriptions.pc88:189994: An action puzzle game that plays like Pac-Man crossed with Bomberman.
descriptions.pc88:189995: Koei's fantasy text adventure with limited commands.
descriptions.pc88:190006: An action game: infiltrate an enemy fortress and free five prisoners of war.
descriptions.pc88:190009: A text adventure based on Jim Henson's The Dark Crystal: the Gelfling Jen sets out to restore the crystal.
descriptions.pc88:190011: An alien visitation story told in three scenarios: driver, policeman and pilot.
descriptions.pc88:190012: An adventure inspired by the Water Margin, told in multiple chapters.
descriptions.pc88:190013: A fantasy role-playing game that begins at a wedding in the village of Kartia.
descriptions.pc88:190014: Hudson's turn-based sci-fi strategy game: command the mobile base Dione and the aircraft it carries.
descriptions.pc88:190021: A sci-fi action game set in 2231 on the pioneer planet Dios, where a mysterious creature is attacking settlers.
descriptions.pc88:190022: Enix's action game: a slug goes around a haunted house exorcising demons.
descriptions.pc88:190023: A fantasy adventure: fearing a dragon's wrath, the king sends a young girl to the Northern Valley as a sacrifice.
descriptions.pc88:190025: Lead the kingdom of Elslead against Bozel’s dark forces in a fantasy strategy campaign.
descriptions.pc88:190027: An action puzzle in the style of Lode Runner: as the Funky Monkey, collect every apple while digging holes to trap the zookeepers; the screen is split into nine panels that can be swapped around.
descriptions.pc88:190028: A fantasy strategy game: the armies of Light and Dark march against each other across the land of Gaia.
descriptions.pc88:190029: A game based on GeGeGe no Kitaro: the young yokai Kitaro defends humans from harmful spirits.
descriptions.pc88:190030: A yakuza strategy game: left in charge of the family by the old boss's will, recruit members, raid neighboring gangs for their turf and open cabarets and pachinko parlors to pay for it.
descriptions.pc88:190033: An adventure based on the first Guin Saga novel: survivors of a royal family, pursued by monsters, meet the leopard-headed warrior Guin.
descriptions.pc88:190034: Game Arts' strategy game of the forty-seven ronin: after their lord's disgrace, plan the vendetta of the Ako retainers.
descriptions.pc88:190036: An action game: dodge cavemen and animals, touch the crystal to summon the time machine Helicoid, and jump from era to era to get back to the present.
descriptions.pc88:190037: An action role-playing game: ages after the forces of light sealed the god of shadow deep underground, he stirs again, and a hero sets out to stop him.
descriptions.pc88:190038: A game based on the manga Hiatari Ryoukou!, following high school student Kasumi Kishimoto and her boarding house life.
descriptions.pc88:190040: A role-playing game: thrown into another dimension that turns out to be the lost continent of Mu, you grow stronger and solve its mysteries to find the way home.
descriptions.pc88:190041: An action game: as a shepherd, catch the sheep outside the fence and put them back in the pen, while others slip out each time the gate is open.
descriptions.pc88:190042: Humanity's technological progress has warped the dimension of time, and you set out to find the Holy Grail that can set the world right. The game has two halves: a real-time action part in which each room is cleared by meeting a condition, and a puzzle-like role-playing search for the Grail, where stamina and weapons saved from the first half matter.
descriptions.pc88:190043: A text-only adventure with no graphics at all, in which you must rescue a princess carried off by the demon lord of the eastern mountain, feeling your way forward by typed commands. It is seen as the starting point of Xtal Soft's later fantasy RPGs.
descriptions.pc88:190044: A puzzle game: a letter and a robot arrive saying a bomb is set to destroy the Mirror Land; teach the robot its moves and use mirrors, lamps and batteries to light its way to the bomb within 45 minutes.
descriptions.pc88:190048: A 3D golf simulation of eighteen holes picked by Jack Nicklaus from major championship courses.
descriptions.pc88:190049: A detective adventure: a Los Angeles detective and a veteran partner investigate a murder linked to Las Vegas.
descriptions.pc88:190050: An action role-playing game: five black monks have thrown the kingdom of Kalgamont into chaos; gather five crystals to lift the princess's curse, talking some monsters out of a fight.
descriptions.pc88:190051: A text adventure: the hunt for the Juggler Stone, said to grant every dream of whoever holds it.
descriptions.pc88:190071: A space role-playing game of scenario sets that share one loader and can be played in any order: build characters from eight races, change jobs, and win back the planet Nasser from a mechanized army.
descriptions.pc88:190072: A seven-disk role-playing adventure by the author of SeeNa: the gods have turned on the people, and seven unlikely heroes, a cat and a fairy among them, each rise against the god of their own land, one disk per country.
descriptions.pc88:190073: A detective adventure: investigate a murder tied to an inheritance at the Kuronekosou estate.
descriptions.pc88:190074: Sequel to Shanghai. In 2025, with East-West tension at breaking point, the UN calls in legendary mercenary Jamie Star to stop secret society chief Mister Khan's germ-weapon project. You choose a version of the hero by strength or other trait, and the party you steer grows each time you find an ally.
descriptions.pc88:190075: Guide Vickey across question-mark tiles in each action-puzzle stage, collecting temporary powers while avoiding enemies.
descriptions.pc88:190076: A PC-88 science-fiction mystery adventure with a spacecraft setting.
descriptions.pc88:190077: Play futuristic pool on oddly shaped tables in solo or two-player matches.
descriptions.pc88:190085: Create characters and lead a party of up to four on a fantasy role-playing journey.
descriptions.pc88:190086: An adventure: after their plane crashes on an African trip, lead Miko and Akemi out of the jungle.
descriptions.pc88:190087: An action game featuring Minky Momo, the heroine of the anime Magical Princess Minky Momo.
descriptions.pc88:190088: A two-player turn-based war strategy game on a 41-by-41 square map.
descriptions.pc88:190089: An adventure: after finishing her novel, the science fiction writer Motoko Hime is pulled into its story.
descriptions.pc88:190090: An action game in the vein of Marble Madness: thrown into another dimension by an earthquake, Bump rolls his survival ball down narrow slopes with sheer drops on both sides, unable ever to stop, past obstacles and monsters back to his own world.
descriptions.pc88:190091: A baseball management game: take over any of the twelve real teams with their funds and players, train your squad, and play dirty off the field by leaking rivals' scandals or hushing up your own.
descriptions.pc88:190092: Micro Cabin's Mystery House, one of the first full-scale Japanese illustrated text adventures: explore a mansion in search of hidden treasure.
descriptions.pc88:190093: An action role-playing game in ancient Egypt: Kaoru Jinguu, born into a family of shrine priests, fights with psychic power that grows in the world of myth.
descriptions.pc88:190094: A baseball management game by the later creator of Derby Stallion: manage a team through a 130-game pennant race and follow the batting and home-run races in detailed player statistics.
descriptions.pc88:190095: Chunsoft's action game: Ron-kun collects all the fruit on each stage while avoiding enemies.
descriptions.pc88:190096: Brain Grey's ninja role-playing game: three heroes, Jakimaru, Gen'yousai and Koheita, each pursue their own story while the others' stories advance alongside and cross it, and every ten days they can meet at a mountain hut to ask each other for help.
descriptions.pc88:190111: A stock market game: grow your fortune by investing in shares, convertible bonds, warrants and commodities while following news bulletins and economic indicators.
descriptions.pc88:190112: An action puzzle game set in the City of One-Way Traffic.
descriptions.pc88:190113: A 3D space shooter with wireframe enemies: fight more than forty kinds of foes with twin lasers and four lock-on missiles, through special stages, planets and a carrier, with a construction mode.
descriptions.pc88:190114: A mahjong action game: as Jankichi, knock tiles down from the conveyor with a hammer to complete winning hands, while dice and riichi sticks fly in to get in the way.
descriptions.pc88:190115: A pyramid maze game: take the apple and pistol, then the diamond that opens the next level; the apple lets you push walls, which can trap enemies, and the mummies cannot be shot.
descriptions.pc88:190116: A text adventure based on the anime Dr. Slump, set in Penguin Village with Arale-chan.
descriptions.pc88:190117: A pinball game with almost eighty tables and multiball play.
descriptions.pc88:190118: Technosoft's first-person space racing game: pilot a spacecraft through a course in outer space.
descriptions.pc88:190119: A Greek myth adventure: the village of Sachiria suffers a drought in an age when gods and humans still lived together.
descriptions.pc88:190120: An action role-playing game without experience points: a young man defends an island from a witch, growing stronger only through the swords, shields and armor he finds.
descriptions.pc88:190121: An adventure: a girl's father, an archaeologist, vanished three days ago while studying a castle; after you both fall through a hole there, explore the castle to find him.
descriptions.pc88:190122: An adventure designed by Katsunori Ishimura, played in real time.
descriptions.pc88:190123: A sci-fi role-playing game blending party combat with exploration.
descriptions.pc88:190124: A role-playing game in Asuka, Nara: someone has broken the seal holding back the demons, and karate captain Togo goes into the underground labyrinth to rescue his teammate Katsuragi.
descriptions.pc88:190125: The kingdom of Saris is razed by the Vifo, an assassin-sorcerer order of the Bahaman theocracy; years later a boy living among mountain bandits begins his journey. An action RPG with no experience points: strength, magic and weapon levels and new spells come from level-up items in treasure chests, and spells need time to cast.
descriptions.pc88:190126: SA-ZI-RI, a shape-shifting life form sealed away long ago by a psychic savior, is stirring again: a colony system goes silent and Princess Rianna's fleet vanishes. Ark Jess Liver must recover the eight parts of the prison shuttle across eight worlds, finding the way to bosses hidden in other dimensions before each part's self-destruct countdown ends.
descriptions.pc88:190128: An adventure: Prill visits the Bukimi forest and finds that all the villagers have been turned to stone.
descriptions.pc88:190129: A four-player mahjong game billed as the strongest of its day, with a study mode; the disk boots on both the PC-8800 series and the PC-8001mkIISR.
descriptions.pc88:190130: An action game: in 1998, three girls are chosen to prevent the final war of Armageddon.
descriptions.pc88:190131: An adventure: captured by the enemy, the hero breaks out of prison and explores Japanese castles.
descriptions.pc88:190132: Aliens have boarded a spaceship and everyone has fled behind the closing shutters, except one boy who stayed behind chasing the bird that escaped from his cage. An action game about getting him through the invaded ship.
descriptions.pc88:190133: A real-time tactical role-playing game loosely based on the legends of Camelot, starring Lancelot.
descriptions.pc88:190134: An action game: fly the BX-1 helicopter against invaders from space around the city's towers.
descriptions.pc88:190135: Bandai's sci-fi game set in 1999: a mission to the Southern Cross.
descriptions.pc88:190136: A vertically scrolling sci-fi shooter of five stages.
descriptions.pc88:190137: A first-person spy adventure with turn-based combat, based on Mission: Impossible.
descriptions.pc88:190138: Falcom's space game combining adventure and trading with shooter segments.
descriptions.pc88:190139: A fantasy adventure: draw the legendary sword from the magic spring to save the kingdom from a demon.
descriptions.pc88:190140: A strategy game based on the film: as Uesugi Kenshin, take the realm, with detailed battles and generals, castles and events; a port of the PC-98 version.
descriptions.pc88:190141: In a small 1970s town in the American South, a thief hires on as temporary chauffeur at the Cairns mansion to steal the cursed crimson emerald Agni within one week. The clock runs in real time: you must drive the master to his office on schedule or be fired, while exploring the mansion as a 3D maze, questioning its eleven residents and driving into town for rumors and supplies.
descriptions.pc88:190143: A Sokoban-like puzzle game from Thinking Rabbit, built around bombs.
descriptions.pc88:190144: An American football game: pick one of five formations and drive for a touchdown against opponents of five classes.
descriptions.pc88:190145: The Transylvania sequel: Princess Sabrina and Crown Prince Erik return when the king falls into danger.
descriptions.pc88:190146: A trivia quiz game covering general knowledge of the world.
descriptions.pc88:190147: A prize winner in Enix's second contest: a single-screen action game of throwing fruit into baskets.
descriptions.pc88:190148: An action role-playing game in ancient Japan, from a story by Aritsune Toyoda: Prince Takeru, fated to live only until seventeen, searches for the mermaid flesh that grants eternal life.
descriptions.pc88:190149: An illustrated parser adventure loosely based on the myth of Ulysses and the Golden Fleece.
descriptions.pc88:190150: A platformer starring Uootoy, a penguin-like creature with a propeller on its head.
descriptions.pc88:190151: A text adventure: the physicist Roman Jason is stranded in an unknown world when his timeship malfunctions.
descriptions.pc88:190152: A baseball game: choose from twelve teams and hit the ball in nine directions.
descriptions.pc88:190153: A graphic adventure based on the anime What's Michael?, about a cat.
descriptions.pc88:190154: Sierra's illustrated text adventure: rescue King George's daughter Priscilla from the evil wizard Harlin.
descriptions.pc88:190155: An action role-playing game: Poco, a wooden doll brought to life, sets out on an adventure.
descriptions.pc88:190156: A computer version of Tsukuda Hobby's Xabungle board wargame Blue Gale, a strategy simulation in which you set out to wipe out Gabletto's forces. It was planned as the first of three games, but the follow-ups were cancelled.
descriptions.pc88:190157: The XZR sequel: after defeating the Caliph, Sadler returns to his village of assassins.
descriptions.pc88:190158: A baseball management simulation built on the 1989 professional season's data.
descriptions.pc88:190160: A baseball management game supervised by Koichi Tabuchi, expanded to all twelve teams.
descriptions.pc88:190161: Wolf Team's action role-playing game: play as Saikuu or Iori.
descriptions.pc88:190162: Hudson's baseball game: play the computer or a friend, or watch two computer teams.
descriptions.pc88:190163: A submarine simulation: destroy the enemy fleet.
descriptions.pc88:190249: A game based on Mitsuru Adachi's manga Touch, about twin brothers Tatsuya and Kazuya and their friend Minami.
descriptions.pc88:190716: Falcom's occult fantasy text adventure from 1984.
descriptions.pc88:190717: A racing game: choose from eight countries' circuits or a course of your own.
descriptions.pc88:190718: Scott Adams' text adventure set in a funhouse.
descriptions.pc88:190719: A role-playing game: the sorcerer Bardick, hailed as a healer during a plague, has taken over the mind of the king of Aldream; explore its dungeons, where people, kobolds among them, ask favors, and battles are fought by moving the party across a grid.
descriptions.pc88:190720: A role-playing game in the American West of 1853: young Jimmy sets out to become the biggest man in South Dakota by mining gold, catching outlaws and talking his way to a fortune.
descriptions.pc88:190756: A role-playing game with action: Ann, who invented a bacterium that breaks down any matter, is kidnapped by the Falcon biker gang, and her former boyfriend Volvo goes after her alone.
descriptions.pc88:191581: The second game in Carry Lab's shogi series, with difficulty settings, saved games and a replay mode that steps through a game move by move.
descriptions.pc88:192923: An arcade wrestling game for one or two players.
descriptions.pc88:193363: A simulation of the Battle of Tsushima in the Russo-Japanese War: as commander of Japan's Combined Fleet you intercept the Russian Baltic Fleet in the decisive naval battle.
descriptions.pc88:193364: A platformer: the boy Dota, whose father is a bioscientist, sets out on an adventure.
descriptions.pc88:193365: A puzzle game: guide CARBO 1 to carry every yellow ball to CARBO 2, which moves only up and down and throws stones at enemies, using one-way and linked moving plates and avoiding bombs.
descriptions.pc88:193366: A calligraphy tool for the mouse: write with pen, eraser and file, and save your work.
descriptions.pc88:193367: Sierra's illustrated parser adventure in the deserted town of Coarsegold: loot the treasures of Cranston Manor.
descriptions.pc88:193368: An action puzzle game: Zuttkun finds ways to open the door to each next level.
descriptions.pc88:193369: A science-fiction role-playing game: up to five pilots in mechanical fighters set out to destroy CRUX, a giant artificial intelligence that has rebelled, collecting bounties for enemy robots at the colonies.
descriptions.pc88:193370: Game Arts' action puzzle game: grab all the keys, then head for the exit.
descriptions.pc88:193371: As supreme commander of the Earth Defense Force you defend the solar system from alien invaders without directly flying anything: you build fighters by fitting engines and proton cannons, program how they react to enemies in a software factory, then launch them and watch the dogfights on monitors, redesigning after losses until the enemy mothership falls.
descriptions.pc88:193372: A riichi mahjong game based on Masayuki Katayama's manga Gambler Jiko Chuushinha.
descriptions.pc88:193373: The second Gambler Jiko Chuushinha: mahjong against twelve more characters on an automatic table, with an octopus-hunting mode.
descriptions.pc88:193374: The third Gambler Jiko Chuushinha: ten more characters, 34 in all with the first two games, and a new villain who wants to fill Japan with octopuses.
descriptions.pc88:193375: A tile-matching puzzle in the manner of Shanghai, with tiles that flip face up when the tiles around them are taken, and advice from the series' characters when you're stuck.
descriptions.pc88:193376: An action puzzle game: Gruppe rescues his friend Pasta.
descriptions.pc88:193377: An action game: Gutchan and Marichan go around town collecting money.
descriptions.pc88:193378: Kogado's role-playing game: monsters pour through the reopened Vandoora passage, and a young hero chosen by the elders sets out to win back the Seal from the monster queen Terarin and close it again.
descriptions.pc88:193379: Hudson's hanafuda card game with three styles of play, including koi-koi.
descriptions.pc88:193380: A war strategy game: people from the future send Japan's Self-Defense Forces back in time to prevent nuclear war, onto battlefields of World War II, Vietnam, the Falklands and the Iran-Iraq War, with only a few modern weapons, factories to build period arms, night moves and spies.
descriptions.pc88:193381: An action game inside the PC-8801 itself: fly a wireframe rocket to wipe out the bugs that have rebelled on the disk interface and DMA controller and restore the machine.
descriptions.pc88:193382: A Thinking Rabbit murder mystery: Scotland Yard receives a strange request from Gilles Willcock, who has been sent a murder notice.
descriptions.pc88:193383: A 3D dungeon role-playing game: an apprentice beast-breeder takes over his master's job of surveying newly found ruins for King Urgan, raising creatures in tanks, whose food, temperature and humidity shape their powers, to explore seven dungeons.
descriptions.pc88:193384: A fishing game with four kinds of fishing: trolling and lure fishing on Alaska's Kenai River, fishing on Skilak Lake, and sea trolling off Vancouver Island; good catches earn an invitation to the Salmon Derby.
descriptions.pc88:193385: A text mystery: the police send you a case file and a disk with access to their crime database, and you solve the case from the evidence alone, with photos, a floor plan and suspect snapshots in the box.
descriptions.pc88:193386: Guide Lefty Mouse through action stages, fighting sea creatures and other hazards.
descriptions.pc88:193387: A simple territory-conquest strategy game for one or more players. From one of five castles you hire soldiers, pay their wages from land income and move troops into areas held by monsters, which multiply at ever shorter intervals; random battle events such as blood-sucking bees or witches can swing your numbers.
descriptions.pc88:193388: Climb a seven-floor tower as a weakened demon lord and battle rivals to regain lost power.
descriptions.pc88:193389: An adventure in which a young wizard's apprentice runs into one trouble after another in a village along her journey.
descriptions.pc88:193390: A prize winner in ASCII's second software contest: dodge six kinds of enemies to collect keys, open the warehouses and take their money and fruit, transforming to breathe fire or slow the guards.
descriptions.pc88:193391: Explore ominous locations and select commands in a Japanese occult adventure.
descriptions.pc88:193392: A hard-boiled detective adventure in black and white: in New York, a rich widow hires you to find three stolen jewels, and one case leads to another.
descriptions.pc88:193393: A Sokoban-style puzzle game: push objects through mazes.
descriptions.pc88:193394: A detective adventure: a born bungler who has just lost another job becomes a rookie detective and searches a house suspected of gun smuggling, with the items hidden in different places each game.
descriptions.pc88:193395: A side-scrolling space shooter starring a girl named Luzzy on a mission.
descriptions.pc88:193396: Missile Command: protect the cities from incoming missile barrages.
descriptions.pc88:193397: Sierra's illustrated text adventure: an astronaut is sent to stop an asteroid on a collision course with Earth.
descriptions.pc88:193398: A Pac-Man-style maze game: Ban travels through a perilous land.
descriptions.pc88:193399: In a sword-and-sorcery land kept alive by the life spring Juju, which has begun to dry up, you choose one of two races, swordsman or magician, and explore top-down dungeons island by island. Characters grow by clearing trials rather than gaining experience, a karma value affects what people tell you, and two can play at once.
descriptions.pc88:193400: Shogi by Kazurou Morita, the strongest shogi program of its day.
descriptions.pc88:193401: A competitive action game like a ball-toss race: bounce the 300 balls that pour out of the shooters off walls and rabbits into your own goal, with balls worth more as the match goes on.
descriptions.pc88:193402: A comedy role-playing game: the philandering prince of the Kinokuniya Kingdom is barred from the castle by the queen until he brings home his runaway wife, Snow White, through a land of parody shops and silly monsters.
descriptions.pc88:193403: The commercial release of the winner of Magical Zoo's first adventure contest.
descriptions.pc88:193404: A baseball action game with a scoreboard full of detail and players under made-up names.
descriptions.pc88:193405: A new version of the racing game SeeNa in which the whole screen scrolls and bobs up and down.
descriptions.pc88:193407: A role-playing game with smooth scrolling and plenty of conversation: centuries after the nine jewels were sealed away, someone drawn by their power breaks the seal.
descriptions.pc88:193408: A five-set singles tennis game with a manual mode that switches between forehand and backhand.
descriptions.pc88:193409: An early dating simulation from Enix, released in 1985, which helped lay the foundations of the genre.
descriptions.pc88:193410: An action adventure in the Marchen Theater: the story of Tonky.
descriptions.pc88:193411: Tsume shogi: checkmate puzzles based on Japanese chess.
descriptions.pc88:196077: Play a computer version of backgammon, moving checkers around the board and wagering points against an opponent.
descriptions.pc88:196078: A doujin tank duel: aim your turret in eight directions to destroy the other tank, against the computer at two difficulty levels or watching it play itself.
descriptions.pc88:196741: A tactical war game of World War II infantry fighting in city streets, with eight scenarios and a map editor; the second in Pony's SPI series.
descriptions.pc88:196742: An expanded Door Door with fifty more levels: Chun traps aliens behind doors.
descriptions.pc88:196866: A role-playing game following three heroines.
descriptions.pc88:196867: An adventure: Nanako Hongou, a new transfer student at St. Belloncho Academy, investigates rumors about the school.
descriptions.pc88:196868: A batting game: guess each pitch's course, type and speed to get a hit before three outs.
descriptions.pc88:196869: Part of the Sexy Voice series: the young Noriko is haunted every night by dreams of an android and turns to a psychiatrist for help.
descriptions.pc88:196870: The third Bishoujo Shashinkan: photograph models through the viewfinder in a studio rigged with mines, pitfalls and a falling ceiling.
descriptions.pc88:196871: A Bishoujo Shashinkan side story about everyday life in a police department.
descriptions.pc88:196872: A photography game: set the location, time, lighting and camera correctly for each shot, or the picture comes out blurred.
descriptions.pc88:196875: An adventure with quizzes: Kaori Shiraishi, a new teacher at a notorious delinquent school, rescues the schoolgirl Manami from a gang, and the two grow close.

descriptions.pc88:196880: A fantasy adventure: a powerful spell suddenly upends a young girl's happy life.

descriptions.pc88:196883: An adventure: a freshman moves into the student dormitory known as the Cosmos Club.

descriptions.pc88:196892: A FairyTale adventure in which the hero is taken to another world.

descriptions.pc88:196902: An adventure: in search of Sayaka, the ideal woman from your dreams, wander unfamiliar towns and beaches.
descriptions.pc88:196904: An adventure: a date at a coffee shop reveals that she is a witch, and you are pulled into her world and must find her to get back.

descriptions.pc88:196917: In each of five rooms a girl waits, and you fulfill her wish to win the key to the next.

descriptions.pc88:196926: An adventure in which the legendary Genji hunts for a killer.

descriptions.pc88:196937: A comic adventure: the student council president is asked by the principal to investigate a school mystery.

descriptions.pc88:196954: A parody adventure of three stories spoofing Tanteidan X and other games.

descriptions.pc88:196965: A conversation game: win the affection of four girls, the first a sixth-grade schoolgirl, by typing topics and replies.
descriptions.pc88:196966: An adventure: rescue Princess Lolita from a castle in Europe, past traps at every turn, in a typed-command game.

descriptions.pc88:196988: A dating game: pick the right replies in conversation to win over each woman.

descriptions.pc88:196996: An action game: race to each Olympic venue before time runs out to watch the women's gymnastics, wrestling and swimming.
descriptions.pc88:196997: A detective adventure: a friend's fiancé is found dead in a park, and you start investigating.

descriptions.pc88:197001: Play blackjack against an illustrated host in a Japanese casino adventure.

descriptions.pc88:197003: Explore a fantasy map, fight creatures, and manage food in an overhead action adventure.

descriptions.pc88:197012: Mika and her boyfriend's late-night phone call, where each right answer wins her over a little more.

descriptions.pc88:197014: A text adventure: caught in a sudden rainstorm, the girl Meo takes shelter and stumbles into a mystery.

descriptions.pc88:197019: A collection of short stories, chosen by the player's gender and one of five age groups, ranging from a children's story about a kitten to a hospital story.

descriptions.pc88:197037: A digitized picture book of model Reina Kitazono: her profile, diary and messages.
descriptions.pc88:197038: An adventure: chosen by the gods to represent humanity, the hero is dropped into another world with only the words "Have fun!"
descriptions.pc88:197039: An adventure: a man's late father leaves him to care for a secret daughter, Eriko.

descriptions.pc88:197086: The fifth Utsukushiki Emono-tachi: pictures set to pop hits by Yoko Minamino and Shizuka Kudo.

descriptions.pc88:197099: The first A-Train: build a railway network that grows the towns along its tracks.

descriptions.pc88:197102: An adventure based on Shizuko Natsuki's novel Dome.
descriptions.pc88:197103: A puzzle game in 50 levels: as UFO-kun, kick walls to shut the aliens behind doors of colors they can't open.
descriptions.pc88:197104: A side-scrolling platformer: a flying robot rescues children from a cave full of creatures.

descriptions.pc88:197106: The Jelda sequel: a first-person 3D space shooter.
descriptions.pc88:197107: Technosoft's sci-fi survival horror game for one or two players.
descriptions.pc88:197108: A side-scrolling action adventure: a fairy drops the crystal that governs good and evil.
descriptions.pc88:197109: A side-scrolling beat 'em up based on Jackie Chan's 1983 film Project A.

descriptions.pc88:197114: The sequel to Schwarzschild, a space strategy game set four years after the first, in 3964.
descriptions.pc88:197115: An action game: a sleepy sheriff throws bombs at bugs and other pests.
descriptions.pc88:197116: A beat 'em up based on Jackie Chan's 1984 film Wheels on Meals.
descriptions.pc88:197117: A sci-fi text adventure: search for Princess Shan.

descriptions.pc88:199666: Explore overhead dungeons as a knight, gathering treasure and defeating monsters through direct action combat.
descriptions.pc88:199679: A doujin vertical shooter famous for its soundtrack by Hitoshi Sakimoto.

descriptions.pc88:201952: Hudson's take on Donkey Kong 3: Stanley the bugman sprays insects to protect his greenhouse from Donkey Kong.
descriptions.pc88:202227: A visual novel loosely tied to Wolf Team's Arcus series.
descriptions.pc88:202373: An arcade shooter: Seiko has been captured by robots, and you fly to the rescue.

descriptions.pc88:204865: A collection of music from Telenet Japan's games.
descriptions.pc88:205608: A fantasy action role-playing game: three dragons appear in the magical world of Forfaral, guarded by five princesses.
descriptions.pc88:205657: A doujin puzzle platformer: a girl in a magnet suit uses attraction and repulsion to reach the goal.

descriptions.pc88:207461: An adventure: find five balls scattered across four worlds.
descriptions.pc88:207462: An adventure: a woman enters the inner chambers of the shogun's castle and works to win her lord's favor.
descriptions.pc88:207463: A school visual novel following a student entering high school.
descriptions.pc88:207464: A text adventure reimagining the Tale of the Bamboo Cutter.
descriptions.pc88:207467: An adventure built on the legend of the Nara-period monk Dokyo, who must cure the troubled Empress by working out what pleases her, with history quiz questions mixed in.
descriptions.pc88:207468: A fantasy text adventure in a world divided into warring Red Ones and Blue Ones.

descriptions.pc88:207480: A puzzle game set in Egypt.
descriptions.pc88:207481: An adventure set in an alternate modern-day Tokyo.
descriptions.pc88:207482: An adventure: a mysterious old man says the door to another world opens for whoever finds three treasures, a famous sword, a secret medicine and ancient documents.
descriptions.pc88:207484: Command units across a map of northern Russia in a World War II strategy game.
descriptions.pc88:207486: A Go program for seasoned players, with a much higher difficulty.
descriptions.pc88:207487: Enix's role-playing game: a modern couple paying respects at a temple cemetery are drawn into a legend.
descriptions.pc88:207504: An adventure in which a journalist covers a big Expo in Japan.
descriptions.pc88:207505: Sevens, the card game, against four girls.
descriptions.pc88:207506: A pon-jan game based on mahjong, played with tiles of fairy-tale characters against Kaguya-hime, Momoko and Otohime.

descriptions.pc88:462679: The first part of Destruction: a TV broadcast is interrupted by a voice saying to look at the midnight sky.

descriptions.pc88:465705: A Qix-style game of claiming territory to reveal a picture.
descriptions.pc88:465933: A shogi game on a carved-wood board: tell the computer which opening to play, such as Sanken Bisha or Yagura, and save and load game records.
descriptions.pc88:465939: ASCII's shogi game, known for its strength and quick moves, with replay, game records and take-backs.

descriptions.pc88:local-09c5dd8711: The sequel to Mature: as a heart, push blocks so the young woman who wanders on her own reaches the door.

descriptions.pc88:local-0d23867040: Xtalsoft's music collection of tracks from its own games.
